fields.source_ref: /root/wt-b5-nextgen/src/components/course/panels/consequence/HarmExplorer.jsx:108 (Probit view, overpressure Probability; input in psig at :94)
fields.evidence: The probit view takes psig, so the learner divides 65000 Pa by PA_PER_PSI as the brief says (advanced/m06.../l04-the-capstone-brief.md:24). Full-precision psig reproduces the answer exactly; psig typed to six decimals moves it by 2.5e-9, well inside tol 5e-7.
fields.notes: Four-decimal psig would move it by 2.5e-6 and fail; the brief says to divide, and a calculator gives full precision.
